description: Answer: How do I bulk verify reconciliation matches? This is the canonical Ledgers workflow for bulk-verify-reconciliation-matches.

Open the exact workflow action labeled for bulk verify reconciliation matches.
Enter required fields for bulk verify reconciliation matches (entity selection, date range, and status where applicable).
Apply changes and execute bulk verify reconciliation matches with explicit confirmation in the UI.
